description: Read the message a banned user sees in this app, and the one a terminated user sees, or change them with `bannedMessage` / `terminatedMessage` ("" puts Neblla's default back). A banned user reads it above a form to write to you; a terminated one has no form, so its message should not point at one.

bannedMessage.description: New message shown to banned users

terminatedMessage.description: New message shown to terminated users

name: neblla_ban_settings
